products.note: AI video avatars; enterprise training; consent management; UK-hosted

profile_text.body:
Colossyan is an AI video and course creation platform aimed at enterprise training and enablement use cases. The company describes itself as a tool that converts existing documents, presentations, and briefs into structured video courses, with AI agents drafting content from uploaded materials while users review and approve each scene before publishing. The platform is positioned as an end-to-end solution rather than a standalone video tool, combining video creation, course authoring, interactive elements such as branching scenarios and quizzes, multi-language localization across 100+ languages, team collaboration, versioning, and SCORM export for LMS delivery in a single workflow.

The platform offers more than 300 AI avatars and voiceovers and supports video generation from PDFs and slide decks. Colossyan notes that users can produce AI videos in under five minutes and that content can be updated and localized without re-recording. The site includes customer references citing cost savings, improved new hire training productivity, and suitability for multilingual environments.

The site's held facts note that Colossyan's product is categorized under video generation and editing, with specific attributes including AI video avatars, enterprise training functionality, consent management, and UK-hosted infrastructure. No litigation, SEC filings, or patent records are present in the available data.
